initial_prompt: What's the difference between crocodiles and alligators?

messages.content: What's the difference between crocodiles and alligators?

Crocodiles have V-shaped snouts and visible teeth when their mouths are closed, while alligators have U-shaped snouts and their teeth are mostly hidden. Crocodiles are also more aggressive and prefer saltwater habitats, whereas alligators are typically found in freshwater and are more docile. The easiest way to tell them apart is the snout shape and whether you can see a big fourth tooth on the lower jaw when the mouth is closed—that's a crocodile.
